'''Nightsister energy bows''' were ranged weapons used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Description==
These unique weapons were used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], [[Witch/Legends|witches]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] in the waning [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].
The bowstrings and arrows of the weapon were made of pure [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]],<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and emitted a bright pink glow. In the middle of the bowstring was a grip, so that the weapon could be fired without harming the user.<ref name="TCWNS">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> When running out of plasma arrows, the string could be used as a bludgeon, to blind or burn the enemy.<ref name="BoS" />

==Usage==
[[File:BoSbow.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Hunter with energy bow at the ready]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], some of the [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] under the command of [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] used these energy bows.<ref name="TCWNS" /> They were known as the [[Hunter (Nightsister)/Legends|Hunters]], a group of special agents clad in red whose task was to follow [[blood trail]]s.<ref name="BoS" />

For every ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a Hunter could earn as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], nine were donated to the clan, in order to continue outfitting them properly with energy bows.<ref name="BoS" />

The skills of a Hunter with her bow was considered to have capital influence on spreading the reputation of the Dathomiri witches. This is why Talzin recommended instructing her Sisters about using this specialty weapon in her manual ''[[Wild Power]]''.<ref name="BoS" />

Many years later, after the instauration of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the energy bows had become extremely rare and exotic weapons&mdash;according to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], who had spent a lot of time on Dathomir.<ref name="BoS" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
At [[Celebration V]], [[Dave Filoni]] stated that this weapon was inspired by the magical bow used in the 80's children's television series ''Dungeons and Dragons''.
